boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces to match independent work, collaboration, writing support, and a change of setting.

cards.title: Trexler Library
cards.subtitle: Three floors of study settings
cards.notes: Start here when you need to choose your own work mode: the library describes options from silent independent study to noisy collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic base with varied seating and study atmospheres.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library says it provides places for noisy collaborative work and silent independent study, with workspaces ranging from carrels to couches and beanbag chairs.
cards.access_notes: Campus visitors are generally permitted in Trexler Library; follow current library access rules and posted hours.

cards.title: AT&T Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library technology workspace
cards.notes: Use this named Trexler Library destination when a project calls for campus technology; check library service guidance before relying on specific equipment.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed information-technology space inside Trexler Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's campus map lists the AT&T Information Commons within Trexler Library, and the library describes computers, printing, collaboration equipment, and presentation-practice resources.
cards.access_notes: Located in Trexler Library; building access and services follow current library policies and hours.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library writing-support destination
cards.notes: Bring a draft or an assignment question and use the campus writing-support location while you work through ideas, structure, and revisions.
cards.short_summary: A named library destination for pairing writing work with campus support.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies Trexler Library as home to its Writing Center, which supports students across disciplines in improving their writing and thinking.
cards.access_notes: Located in Trexler Library; confirm current Writing Center appointment or drop-in arrangements before visiting.

cards.title: Altman Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fahy Commons reading room
cards.notes: Choose this named reading-room setting for a focused session near Fahy Commons, then verify current building access before making it your base.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed reading room in Fahy Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's campus map lists the Altman Reading Room in Fahy Commons for Public Engagement and Innovation.
cards.access_notes: Fahy Commons is a campus academic building; access may vary by building operations and scheduled activity.

cards.entity_name: Fahy Commons for Public Engagement and Innovation
cards.title: Fahy Commons
cards.subtitle: Academic building with classroom and gathering spaces
cards.notes: Use Fahy Commons as a change-of-scene work stop, especially when its academic spaces are open and no scheduled use limits the area.
cards.short_summary: A newer academic building with technology-equipped classrooms and gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg describes Fahy Commons as an academic building with classroom spaces featuring state-of-the-art technology, plus a large lower-level gathering area and patio.
cards.source_title: Conferences and External Events | Muhlenberg College
cards.access_notes: Classrooms and gathering areas can be scheduled for events; confirm availability and access before settling in.

cards.entity_name: Leffell Center Beit Midrash and Library
cards.title: Leffell Center Beit Midrash and Library
cards.subtitle: Leffell Center for Jewish Student Life
cards.notes: For text-based work in a dedicated library setting, check the Leffell Center's current programming and access information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named beit midrash and library within the Jewish student-life center.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says the Leffell Center includes a dedicated sanctuary, a beit midrash and library, an institutional kitchen, offices, and a student-designated lounge.
cards.source_title: Hillel - Jewish Life at Muhlenberg | Muhlenberg College
cards.access_notes: This is part of the Leffell Center for Jewish Student Life; respect active services, programs, and community use.

cards.title: Leffell Center Student-Designated Lounge
cards.subtitle: Leffell Center for Jewish Student Life
cards.notes: Use the student-designated lounge as a possible informal work setting, while yielding to community programs and observing center access expectations.
cards.short_summary: An explicitly student-designated lounge in the Leffell Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies a student-designated lounge among the facilities at the Leffell Center for Jewish Student Life.
cards.source_title: Hillel - Jewish Life at Muhlenberg | Muhlenberg College
cards.access_notes: Availability can be affected by Hillel services and events; consult its current student calendar or staff if unsure.

cards.title: Seegers Union Event Space
cards.subtitle: Seegers Union reservable venue
cards.notes: Consider this space only when it is not reserved: it has event technology support, so check the Union schedule before planning a group session.
cards.short_summary: A named Seegers Union venue equipped for sound, video, and live streaming.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's student-organization policies identify Seegers Union Event Space as a venue with lighting, sound, video, and live-streaming support.
cards.access_notes: This is an event venue; reservations and scheduled programming may restrict use.

cards.title: Seegers Union Great Room
cards.subtitle: Seegers Union meeting venue
cards.notes: Use the Great Room for a planned group session only when it is open and unreserved; its setup supports presentations as well as meetings.
cards.short_summary: A named Seegers Union room with sound, video, and effect-lighting support.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's student-organization policies state that the Great Room in Seegers Union has a full sound system, video, and effect lighting.
cards.access_notes: The Great Room is a scheduled event venue; confirm that it is available before using it for study.

cards.title: Seegers Union Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: Seegers Union lounge venue
cards.notes: Try this named lounge for an informal group work session, but check event activity first and keep the setup intact unless staff approve changes.
cards.short_summary: A Seegers Union lounge with limited sound-system and uplighting support.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's student-organization policies list the Fireside Lounge in Seegers Union and state that limited sound-system and uplighting support are available.
cards.access_notes: The lounge may be used for scheduled programs; verify availability with Seegers Union before depending on it.
